roots.origin: 拉丁语 cavere（当心、提防、留神看着），过去分词 cautus → 名词 cautio；与 cavus（中空的）及其派生 cave（洞穴）无关，是两个拉丁词，勿混
roots.core_concept: to beware, to watch out beforehand / 先提防着、留神看着
roots.core_image: 脚尖先探一探前面的路面，压一压听有没有响，才把整个身子的重量交上去
roots.english_definition: to beware, to guard against beforehand

concepts.concept: to beware, to watch out beforehand
concepts.core_image: 脚尖先探一探前面的路面，压一压听有没有响，才把整个身子的重量交上去

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ cil（concilium 召集到一处）→ 被召到一处议事的那群人
words.origin: 古法语 conseil / concile 在英语里混同，本词出拉丁语 concilium（集会、联盟）← com-（一起）+ calare（召唤）；与 consulere（商议、求教）不同源，counsel 才属那一支
words.native_definition: a group of people chosen to make decisions or give advice
words.core_concept: a body called together to decide – 被召集到一处做决定的一群人
words.core_image: 长桌两边坐满人，每人面前一份文件，主位敲一下木槌，逐项过一遍
examples: The city council voted against the new road.
She sits on the student council.
semantic_expansions: 委员会：为某事被召集起来的一小群人
议会：地方上有决策权的那个机构
理事会：一个组织内部定事的常设班子

words.origin: 古法语 cristal ← 拉丁语 crystallus ← 希腊语 krystallos（冰、水晶）← kryos（霜、冰寒）；与希腊语 krinein（判别）无关，不属 crit 一支
words.native_definition: a clear hard mineral that forms in regular flat-sided shapes
words.core_concept: clear stuff frozen into flat faces – 清透之物长成一个个平面
words.core_image: 一块透亮的石头，每个面都平，转一下角度就有一道光从里面折出来
examples: The cave walls were lined with tiny crystals.
Salt forms crystals as the water dries.
semantic_expansions: 水晶：透亮的那种石头本身
结晶：溶液里慢慢长出规整颗粒的过程
晶体：内部按规矩排列、外面带平面的那类固体
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: domin（dominus 家主、主人）+ -arium（权限）→ 落进别人手里、由他处置
words.origin: 古法语 dangier ← 通俗拉丁语 *dominiarium（主人的权力、处置权）← 拉丁语 dominus（家主）
words.native_definition: the possibility that something bad or harmful may happen
words.core_concept: being in another's hands, not your own – 落在别人手里，由不得自己
words.core_image: 站在窄窄的檐口上，脚下没有东西托着，身子已经不由自己，全看下一步落在哪里
examples: The bridge is old and full of danger.
Smoking is a danger to your health.
semantic_expansions: 危险：处境已不受自己掌握，随时可能出事
危害：那股力量真的落到人或物身上

words.root_logic: prae-（预先）+ caut（cavere 当心、留神）→ 事情还没来，先留神着做点什么
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecautio ← praecavere：prae-（预先）+ cavere（当心、提防）
words.native_definition: something done in advance to stop a possible problem
words.core_concept: acting before the trouble arrives – 麻烦还没到就先动手
words.core_image: 出门时天还晴着，包里先塞了一把伞，因为昨夜听见过风声
examples: Take an umbrella as a precaution.
They locked the door as a precaution.
semantic_expansions: 预防措施：为挡住可能的坏事而先做的那件具体的事
防范：整体上先留着的那份戒心

words.origin: 古法语 conceler ← 拉丁语 concelare：com-（彻底）+ celare（藏起）；本项目未为 celare 一支建根
words.native_definition: to hide something so that it cannot be seen or found out
words.core_concept: putting a thing where eyes cannot reach – 放到眼睛到不了的地方
words.core_image: 把信塞进地板缝里，又把床单铺平压好，屋里看不出动过的痕迹
examples: He tried to conceal the letter in his coat.
She could not conceal her surprise.
semantic_expansions: 隐藏：把实物挪到看不见的地方
隐瞒：把消息或情绪扣住不让人知道
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 connexio ← connectere：com-（一起）+ nectere（系、缚）；本项目未为 nectere 一支建根
words.native_definition: a link between two things, people, or ideas
words.core_concept: two things tied so one reaches the other – 两头系住，这边能通到那边
words.core_image: 两根电线的铜头绞在一处，缠上胶布，灯一下就亮了
examples: There is no connection between the two cases.
The train connection was delayed.
semantic_expansions: 连接：两个东西实际接上了
联系：人与人之间来往的那条线
关系：两件事之间说得出的那层牵连
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 contraire ← 拉丁语 contrarius ← contra（对面、迎面）；contra 是前缀性成分，本项目未为其单独建根
words.native_definition: completely different, or the opposite of something
words.core_concept: facing the other way – 脸朝着另一边
words.core_image: 两个人背靠背站着，一个往东迈步，另一个同时往西
examples: His view is contrary to mine.
On the contrary, I enjoyed it.
semantic_expansions: 相反的：方向或说法正好倒过来
对立的：两者不只不同，还互相顶着
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 coper ← 晚期拉丁语 cuprum ← aes cyprium（塞浦路斯的金属），该岛古时产此矿
words.native_definition: a soft reddish-brown metal that carries heat and electricity well
words.core_concept: the red metal that came from that island – 从那座岛上来的红色金属
words.core_image: 一根旧水管刮掉锈，底下是红黄色的亮面，放久了又蒙上一层青绿
examples: The pipes in this house are made of copper.
He paid with a few coppers.
semantic_expansions: 铜：那种红黄色的软金属
铜币：用它铸的小面额钱
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.root_logic: corr（currere 跑、来回走）+ -dor（处所）→ 供人来回走动的那条长条地方
words.origin: 法语 corridor ← 意大利语 corridore（可供奔走的长条地方）← correre ← 拉丁语 currere（跑）
words.native_definition: a long narrow passage inside a building with doors along the sides
words.core_concept: a long strip made for moving through – 专供人来回走的一条长地方
words.core_image: 楼里一条又长又窄的过道，两侧一排门，脚步声在头顶来回响
examples: Her office is at the end of the corridor.
We waited in the corridor outside.
semantic_expansions: 走廊：楼里连着各房间的那条长条空间
通道：任何供穿行的狭长路线

words.origin: 法语 coupon（剪下的一小片）← couper（剪、切）← 古法语 colp ← 晚期拉丁语 colpus（一击）；本项目未为这一支建根
words.native_definition: a small printed piece of paper that gives you a right to something
words.core_concept: a small piece cut off the sheet – 从整张上剪下来的一小片
words.core_image: 报纸角上印着一小块虚线框，沿线剪下来，到店里能抵一部分钱
examples: She cut out the coupon from the magazine.
This coupon gives you ten percent off.
semantic_expansions: 优惠券：剪下来能少付钱的那一小片
票证：凭它领取或兑换某物的凭据
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 curteisie ← curteis（合乎庭中体面的）← cort（庭院、宫廷）← 拉丁语 cohortem（围起来的院子）；本项目未为这一支建根
words.native_definition: polite behaviour that shows respect for other people
words.core_concept: the manner kept in another's yard – 在别人的场面上该有的样子
words.core_image: 进门时替后面的人扶住门，等他走过去才松手
examples: He held the door open out of courtesy.
She greeted them with great courtesy.
semantic_expansions: 礼貌：待人时那份不抢先、不冒犯的态度
礼节：场面上照例要做的那些具体动作
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: domin（dominus 家主、主人）+ -arium（权限）+ -ous（有…性质的）→ 会把人攥在手里的
words.origin: 古法语 dangereus ← dangier ← 通俗拉丁语 *dominiarium（主人的处置权）← 拉丁语 dominus（家主）
words.native_definition: likely to cause harm or damage to someone
words.core_concept: able to take you out of your own hands – 能把人从自己手里夺走的
words.core_image: 那段路刚下过雨，路肩上没有护栏，车轮一偏就直接下去了
examples: It is dangerous to swim here alone.
He drove at a dangerous speed.

words.root_logic: de-（缺、去掉）+ fic（facere 做、造）→ 该凑够的没凑够，短了一块
words.origin: 拉丁语 deficit（它短缺，deficere 的第三人称单数）← deficere：de-（去掉）+ facere（做、造）
words.native_definition: the amount by which money spent is more than money received
words.core_concept: what was not made up to the mark – 该做够的地方没做够
words.core_image: 账本最后一行是个负数，进来的钱没盖住出去的钱
examples: The company reported a large deficit.
They cut spending to reduce the deficit.
semantic_expansions: 赤字：账上出的比进的多，那个差额
亏空：钱或物已经短了一块，补不上
逆差：一国对外买进多于卖出的那部分差数

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 deprivare：de-（彻底）+ privare（夺走、使孤单）← privus（各自的、单个的）；本项目未为 privus 一支建根
words.native_definition: to take something away from someone that they need or should have
words.core_concept: pulling away what was someone's own – 把本属于他的那份抽走
words.core_image: 原本攥在他手里的东西被人一件件拿走，最后摊开的手心是空的
examples: The new rule deprives them of their rights.
Lack of sleep deprived him of energy.
semantic_expansions: 剥夺：把权利或资格从人手里强行取走
使丧失：让人失去某种本有的东西或状态
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: de-（定住）+ stin（stare 站定）+ -ation → 出发前就已经定住不动的那个落脚处
words.origin: 拉丁语 destinatio ← destinare（定下、指定）← de- + *stanare ← stare（站立、立定）
words.native_definition: the place that someone or something is going to
words.core_concept: the point fixed before the journey starts – 出发之前就已经定住的那一点
words.core_image: 车票上印着一个站名，中途换几趟车都不算，最后停下的就是那一个点
examples: Their destination was a small fishing village.
The parcel reached its destination.
semantic_expansions: 目的地：人或物要去的那个地方
终点：一段路程最后停下的位置

words.origin: 拉丁语 determinare：de-（彻底）+ terminare ← terminus（界石、边界）；本项目未为 terminus 一支建根
words.native_definition: to decide something officially, or to find out something exactly
words.core_concept: driving in the stake that fixes the line – 把界桩钉死，线就定在那里
words.core_image: 在地上钉进一根木桩，绳子绕上去拉紧，从此这条边就不再挪动
examples: The court will determine who owns the land.
We must determine the cause first.
semantic_expansions: 决定：正式定下某事怎么办
确定：把原先不明的范围或数值定住
查明：把事实弄清楚到不再有疑
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 diplomatique ← 拉丁语 diploma（对折的官方文书）← 希腊语 diplōma ← diploun（对折）；与库中 plic 所据的 plicare（折叠）同出印欧折叠之义，但希腊与拉丁两支已分化，且今义要经 diploma（文书）才转得过来，故未并入
words.native_definition: relating to relations between countries, or skilled at handling people
words.core_concept: carrying the folded letter between states – 拿着对折的文书在两国之间走动
words.core_image: 两边隔着长桌说话，声音压得低，句子留半截，谁也不把话逼到没有退路
examples: The two sides resumed diplomatic talks.
She gave a diplomatic answer to the question.
semantic_expansions: 外交的：与国家之间往来事务有关的
圆通的：说话办事不把人得罪、留着余地的
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 elementarius ← elementum（构成万物的基本部分），更早词源不明；本项目未为 elementum 一支建根
words.native_definition: at the most basic level, or dealing with the first steps of a subject
words.core_concept: the first pieces a thing is built from – 一样东西最开头的那几块
words.core_image: 黑板上只留最开头那几个式子，底下写着先把这些背下来
examples: He made an elementary mistake in the calculation.
She teaches at an elementary school.
semantic_expansions: 基本的：属于最起头、再往下拆不动的那一层
初级的：面向刚入门的人、只讲开头部分的
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 eliminare（赶出门槛外）：ex-（出）+ limen（门槛）；limen（门槛）与库中 limes（田界、边界）是两个拉丁名词，语义已分，本项目未合并
words.native_definition: to remove something completely, or to knock someone out of a contest
words.core_concept: putting it out over the threshold – 推出门槛，不让再进来
words.core_image: 名单上一行行划掉，划到最后只剩一个名字
examples: We must eliminate all errors before printing.
Their team was eliminated in the first round.
semantic_expansions: 消除：把某种东西彻底去掉
淘汰：在比赛或筛选中把人或物剔出去
排除：从考虑范围里把某项拿掉
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 emigratus ← emigrare：ex-（出）+ migrare（迁移）；本项目未为 migrare 一支建根
words.native_definition: to leave your own country in order to live in another one
words.core_concept: moving out of where you belonged – 从自己原属的地方迁出去
words.core_image: 钥匙交回房东，箱子一只只搬上船，岸上的人越站越小
examples: Her parents emigrated to Canada in 1980.
Many young workers emigrate for better pay.
semantic_expansions: 移居国外：离开本国到别国长住
外迁：整体上往外搬走这个动作
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 empereor ← 拉丁语 imperator（统帅）← imperare（下令、统辖）：in-（向）+ parare（备置）；承义的是下令统辖这一支，不是备置，故未挂 parare
words.native_definition: the male ruler of an empire
words.core_concept: the one whose word moves everyone – 一句话就能调动所有人的那个人
words.core_image: 台阶最上面坐着一个人，下面几百人跪着，他只抬了一下手指
examples: The emperor ordered a new palace to be built.
He ruled as emperor for thirty years.
semantic_expansions: 皇帝：统辖整个帝国的最高统治者
君主：世袭掌国的那一类统治者
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: co-（一同）+ oper（operari 劳作、投入工作）+ -ative → 力气往同一处使
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 cooperativus ← cooperari：com-（一同）+ operari（劳作）← opus（工作）
words.native_definition: willing to work together with others, or a business owned by its members
words.core_concept: effort put in alongside another – 力气跟别人使在一处
words.core_image: 两个人抬同一根木头，一个起身另一个立刻跟上，步子踩在一个点上
examples: The witness was very cooperative with the police.
They joined a farmers' cooperative.
semantic_expansions: 合作的：愿意与人一同出力的
乐于配合的：别人要做什么就顺着接上的
合作社：由社员共同出资共同经营的那种组织

words.origin: 古英语 cūðe（cunnan 知道、会 的过去式）← 原始日耳曼语 *kunnan；拼写里的 l 是后人比着 would / should 加进去的，本不发音
words.native_definition: used to say what someone was able to do, or to ask and suggest politely
words.core_concept: the knowing-how that was there then – 那时候手上有的那份本事
words.core_image: 年轻时一口气能爬到山顶，如今上两层楼就要停一停
examples: She could swim before she was four.
Could you pass me the salt?
semantic_expansions: 能：过去有这个本事或条件
可以：请求或提议时把话说软一格
可能：对眼下或将来的一种不很确定的估计
collocations: could have done sth —— 本来做得到却没做，含惋惜或责怪
Could you do sth? —— 请求对方做事，比 can 更客气
could hardly do sth —— 几乎做不到，程度贴近否定
if... could do sth —— 与现在事实相反的假设，虚拟语气
words.recall_hint: 同一个词既回头说从前办得到，也用来把话说得客气、把口气留出余地
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语内部合成：country + side；country ← 古法语 contree ← 通俗拉丁语 contrata（对面铺展开的那片地）← 拉丁语 contra（对面）
words.native_definition: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods, and few buildings
words.core_concept: the land spread out over against the town – 跟城相对着铺开的那一片地
words.core_image: 车窗外一片片田挨着走，中间散着几棵树、几间矮房，很久看不见一个红灯
examples: They bought a small house in the countryside.
We drove through open countryside all day.
semantic_expansions: 乡村：城外那片以田野林木为主的地方
农村：以种田为生的人聚居的那一带
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 crypel ← 原始日耳曼语 *krupilaz（爬行者）← *kreupan（爬）
words.native_definition: to damage someone or something so badly that it can no longer work properly
words.core_concept: brought down to crawling – 弄到只能爬着走
words.core_image: 一条腿拖在后面，每走一步都要把身子往旁边甩一下才带得动
examples: The accident crippled him for life.
Heavy debts crippled the small company.
semantic_expansions: 使丧失能力：把人的行动或机能弄坏
严重损害：把机构、经济等打到运转不起来
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 crulle ← 中古荷兰语 krul（卷曲的）；英语里 r 换了位置成 curl
words.native_definition: to form into a curved or spiral shape, or a piece of hair in that shape
words.core_concept: turning in upon itself – 自己往里绕成圈
words.core_image: 刨下来的木片自己卷成一圈圈，松手就越缩越紧
examples: The paper curled up in the heat.
She has thick black curls.
semantic_expansions: 卷曲：边缘或整体绕成圈的这个动作或状态
卷发：头发天然或做成的那种圈状
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 1982 年英语新造词：cyber-（截自 cybernetics 控制论，与 gubernare 掌舵 一支语义已分，今只作构词前缀）+ space；更早可溯希腊语舵手一词，但那层意思今义里已不可见
words.native_definition: the imagined space in which electronic messages and data move
words.core_concept: a place that exists only in the wires – 只存在于线路里的一个地方
words.core_image: 人坐在椅子上没动，屏幕那头是几千公里外的人，一来一往像面对面
examples: Millions of people meet daily in cyberspace.
Crime in cyberspace is hard to trace.
semantic_expansions: 网络空间：电子信息往来所构成的那个场域
虚拟空间：并非实体、只在设备中成立的空间
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: dia-（来回、穿过）+ log（logos 话语）→ 话在两个人之间来回过
words.origin: 拉丁语 dialogus ← 希腊语 dialogos ← dialegesthai：dia-（来回）+ legein（说）
words.native_definition: a conversation between two or more people, especially in a book or play
words.core_concept: words passing back and forth – 话语在两边来回走
words.core_image: 剧本上一行接一行，左边名字换来换去，两个人一句顶一句地把事说开
examples: The novel is full of sharp dialog.
The two sides opened a direct dialog.
semantic_expansions: 对话：双方轮着说话，也指正式的会谈
对白：剧本或影片里人物所说的话

words.origin: 古英语 dūce（潜水的鸟）← *dūcan（俯身、扎入水中）← 原始日耳曼语 *dūkan
words.native_definition: a common water bird with a wide flat beak, or to lower your head quickly
words.core_concept: going head-down in one quick dip – 头一低，一下扎下去
words.core_image: 水面上的鸟一头扎下去，水圈还在晃，它已经从几步远的地方冒出来
examples: A row of ducks crossed the muddy path.
He ducked as the ball flew past.
semantic_expansions: 鸭子：那种扁嘴会潜水的水鸟
低头躲避：人把头猛一低让开的动作
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 ēasterne：ēast（← 原始日耳曼语 *aust- 日出那边）+ -erne（方位后缀）
words.native_definition: in or from the side of a country or area where the sun comes up
words.core_concept: the side the light comes from first – 光最先到的那一侧
words.core_image: 天刚亮那会儿，光先落在这一侧的山坡上，另一侧还是暗的
examples: They live on the eastern edge of the city.
Eastern winds brought colder weather.
semantic_expansions: 东部的：位于某地区靠日出那一侧的
东方的：属于地球上东边那一大片区域的
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 eahta ← 原始日耳曼语 *ahtōu ← 原始印欧语 *oḱtṓw
words.native_definition: the number 8
words.core_concept: two hands with the thumbs folded in – 两只手扣起拇指剩下的那些指头
words.core_image: 两只手摊开，把两根拇指往里扣住，剩下立着的指头就是这个数
examples: There are eight chairs around the table.
The train leaves at eight in the morning.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
